caption: A stolen identity becomes a valid API key. The key reads a bucket whose policy grants read to any authenticated user, holding 10,000 records. The records leave as a breach. No single step is a provider platform break; each step is a customer-side control failure.

spec.title: One attack path
spec.aria: A four-step attack path from weak identity controls to a stolen key, a bucket policy that grants read to any authenticated user, and a data breach.
